definitions.explanation: The level or year a student is in at school (e.g., first grade, second year).
The annual period of schooling, typically from April to March in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧3{学年|がくねん}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: My son is in the third grade of elementary school.

examples.japanese: {学年|がくねん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しく→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Studying gets harder as you advance in grade level.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{学年|がくねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{学年|がくねん}は4{月|がつ}に{始|はじ}まる。
examples.english: The school year in Japan starts in April.

examples.japanese: {学年|がくねん}{末|まつ}の{試験|しけん}が{近|ちか}づいてきた。
{新|しん}{学年|がくねん}が{始|はじ}まって、クラス{替|が}えがあった。
examples.english: The new school year started and classes were reshuffled.

notes:
{学年|がくねん} refers to both the grade level and the school year itself.

School grades in Japan:
- {小学|しょうがく}1〜6{年|ねん} (Elementary 1-6)
- {中学|ちゅうがく}1〜3{年|ねん} (Junior High 1-3)
- {高校|こうこう}1〜3{年|ねん} (High School 1-3)

Common expressions:
- {学年|がくねん}が{上|あ}がる (to advance a grade)
- {同|おな}じ{学年|がくねん} (same grade level)
- {上|うえ}/{下|した}の{学年|がくねん} (upper/lower grade)
- {学年|がくねん}{末|まつ} (end of school year)

Note: The Japanese school year starts in April and ends in March.
